summary: VS-017 research compendium provides comprehensive analysis of procedural world streaming for 5.76km² sandbox. Document is deeply enriched with 300+ links and extensive code samples. All acceptance criteria are addressed with actionable implementation guidance.

strengths.description: Exceptionally comprehensive research with 300+ curated links covering Godot 4.6 PCG3D, FastNoiseLite, chunk streaming, collision optimization, and LOD systems.
Detailed analysis of existing world_renderer.gd implementation with specific constants (WORLD_HALF_EXTENT_M = 1200.0 for 5.76km², PROCEDURAL_CHUNK_SIZE_M = 160.0) and chunk lifecycle documentation.
Numerous high-quality code samples including complete chunk class implementation, procedural river system, and child-safe prop selector.
All VS-017 acceptance criteria explicitly addressed with implementation details and verification strategies.
Thorough performance analysis with budget recommendations (3.5ms per frame), disposal rates, and memory management strategies.
Comprehensive testing section with determinism tests, performance tests, and boundary tests for the procedural world system.
Dedicated child-safety section with ChildSafePropSelector implementation that filters out inappropriate content (skulls, weapons, monsters, etc.).
Clear integration notes and references to existing codebase, making it easy to apply research findings.

suggestions.description: Consider creating a migration plan from current custom chunk system to Godot 4.6 native PCG3D nodes for long-term maintainability.
Add a summary section at the top with quick-start guide for developers new to the procedural world system.
Consider adding automated tests for chunk determinism across different world seeds.

notes: The research document serves as both specification and implementation guide for the 5.76km² procedural world.
The existing world_renderer.gd already implements most VS-017 requirements with WORLD_HALF_EXTENT_M = 1200.0 (2.4km × 2.4km).
VS-017 focuses on scaling and collision, while VS-019 (which shares this document) focuses on streaming biomes around the player.
The document provides extensive code samples that can be directly applied to the codebase.
Child safety considerations are well-integrated with the ChildSafePropSelector class.
300+ links provide valuable external resources for implementation.

decision.reason: Comprehensive research document meets all acceptance criteria with extensive code samples, testing strategies, and child-safety considerations. Ready for integration.
